method: Independently reopened both original PNGs in this fresh author batch after reading both complete approved lessons and both complete worked examples in both languages. No prior author object list or inventory was used.

items.observation: Upper left: two visible short/long cell-symbol pairs, both short plates on the left and long plates on the right. Dots between the visible pairs indicate an abbreviated battery; this is not an exact two-cell-count claim.
items.requirement: Preserve the visible two pairs, shared orientation, battery abbreviation and two external battery terminals.

items.observation: A single rectangular series circuit. The battery connects along the top to the left side of a circular ammeter labelled A; the ammeter right side returns via the right side and bottom to the right end of the rectangular sensing element. The sensing element left end returns along the bottom and left side to the battery. No branch, switch or junction dot.
items.requirement: Preserve battery-to-meter-to-element series topology with distinct two-terminal components; do not short any component.

items.observation: One circle in the upper right with the letter A inside. No needle, scale, numerical reading or current arrow is shown in this figure.
items.requirement: Preserve the circular A symbol with its left and right terminals. Do not add a quantified reading.

items.observation: One long unfilled horizontal rectangle in the lower right branch. A lead touches each short vertical end. The lesson identifies this as the temperature-sensitive semiconductor element.
items.requirement: Preserve one horizontal sensing element as a two-terminal component, not a generic unrelated load.

items.observation: Immediately below the sensing element: a small burner-like base and a tall outlined flame with an inner flame/wick trace. It is physically separate from the circuit and heats the element from beneath.
items.requirement: Retain a recognisable lit laboratory burner with flame beneath the thermistor; do not replace it with an abstract arrow or resistor symbol, and do not connect the heat source electrically.

modernAdditions: English Battery and Thermistor identification labels; no additional causal claims or numerical data.
Modern isolated burner artwork with restrained natural flame colour, replacing scan texture while retaining heat-source identity.
Schematic spacing and enlarged labels; no dimensions are source measurements.

routing.reason: Exact series connectivity, cell-symbol orientation and label placement are deterministic. The recognisable burning heat source carries necessary natural object identity and is generated as separate artwork.

items.observation: One short/long cell pair in the upper left branch, long plate on the left and short plate on the right.
items.requirement: Preserve the single cell and its visible orientation, distinct from the opposite orientation and abbreviated multi-cell battery in figure 229.

items.observation: One closed rectangular loop. The cell right terminal runs to the left lower terminal of the elevated circular analog meter. The right lower meter terminal runs along the top and right sides to the element right terminal, and the element left terminal returns along the bottom and left side to the cell left terminal. The two meter leads are separated beneath the case, not joined together.
items.requirement: Maintain one series circuit and the two separated lower meter terminals. No bypass wire through the meter, branch or switch.

items.observation: An elevated round analog meter with outer rim, an arched scale and many small unnumbered tick marks. The needle rises from a low central pivot toward the upper-left part of the scale, not zero or far right. No reliably readable numeric scale, unit or A glyph is present.
items.requirement: Preserve the circular analog apparatus, arched unnumbered scale and low-side upper-left pointer. The approved text identifies an ammeter, allowing a modern A label. Tick density is not a numerical calibration or queried count.

items.observation: One long unfilled horizontal rectangular element in the lower branch with one wire attached to each end. The full text identifies the light-sensitive semiconductor element.
items.requirement: Preserve the photoresistor component and two-terminal attachments, without inserting heating apparatus.

items.observation: No lamp, flame, light-ray arrow, Light label or current-direction arrow is shown. A small isolated curved speck inside the loop is not connected to any component and does not depict incoming illumination.
items.requirement: Preserve the baseline state before the separate illuminated figure 231. Omit the disconnected scan blemish rather than inventing a component or light ray.

unresolvedPixels: The exact count of tiny analog tick marks is not a source-given measurement; preserve an unnumbered analog scale and the pointer relationship, not an invented quantitative reading.
modernAdditions: English Cell and Photoresistor labels and central A identification from the approved lesson, not decoded source glyphs.
A regularised unnumbered dial scale with no values; no exact original tick count is claimed.
Schematic spacing and enlarged labels; no absolute needle current, zero-current condition or comparison ratio is invented.

routing.reason: This is apparatus geometry with a meaningful needle position, two separated meter connections and circuit continuity. No natural scene or incident-light artwork is present or needed.
